The hedge fund run by Peter Adam Hochfelder held 46.47M shares of the broadcasting company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $249.07 million, up from 45.89M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brahman Capital Corp who had been investing in Sirius Xm Hldgs Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $31.19B market cap company. The stock increased 1.38% or $0.095 $6.965.
